final: WITH ratios AS (SELECT p.SEX, CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / l.GPT AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT != 0), group_avgs AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(ratio) AS group_avg FROM ratios GROUP BY SEX), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS value FROM group_avgs), kept_first AS (SELECT g.group_avg FROM group_avgs g, first_mean WHERE g.group_avg > first_mean.value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS value FROM kept_first), kept_second AS (SELECT g.group_avg FROM kept_first g, second_mean WHERE g.group_avg > second_mean.value) SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS final_avg_ratio, AVG(group_avg - (SELECT value FROM first_mean)) AS avg_exceeding_first_mean, AVG(group_avg - (SELECT value FROM second_mean)) AS avg_exceeding_second_mean FROM kept_second
